meta.title: Broker / Sub-Vendor Flow: refused for a user without the Broker / Channel Partner role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Broker / Channel Partner role and verify the Broker / Sub-Vendor Flow is refused or absent
Use the Broker / Sub-Vendor Flow to onboard and manage sub-vendors with the PO issued to the supplier
Repeat the flow as a Broker / Channel Partner and verify it is available
Compare the two users' outcomes and determine whether tenant RBAC grants the capability to additional roles
Verify the tenant is on the Enterprise plan
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Broker / Channel Partner role and verify the Broker / Sub-Vendor Flow is refused or absent; Use the Broker / Sub-Vendor Flow to onboard and manage sub-vendors with the PO issued to the supplier; Repeat the flow as a Broker / Channel Partner and verify it is available; Compare the two users' outcomes and determine whether tenant RBAC grants the capability to additional roles; Verify the tenant is on the Enterprise plan

args.need: sign in as both the user without the Broker / Channel Partner role and the Broker / Channel Partner user, exercise the Broker / Sub-Vendor Flow to onboard and manage sub-vendors with the PO issued to the supplier, and compare whether the flow is refused or absent for the first user and available for the second
